title: Canonical finite projections of completed constant realization
statement: For the canonical finite projections of [def-weil-pbc-completed-constant-finite-projections], prove naturality for completion-linear module maps and compatibility with every successor quotient transition. Define their compatible cone and its unique map to the completed constant-module limit. Its composites with the limit projections are the specified finite projections. This construction is valid for arbitrary completion modules and asserts no invertibility.

source.place: Tag 03EK and Tags 093J--093M; quotient scalar actions, sheafified scalar extension, and the explicit tensor-to-limit map

proof.text: On actual constant tensor generators, functorial scalar extension keeps the completed scalar and applies the module map to the element. The induced quotient map is linear over the quotient ring. The proved projection formula gives naturality on these generators; local tensor generation extends it to the sheaf morphisms.

The quotient factor map is semilinear between the two finite quotient rings. Sheafify it and compute the resulting map on underlying additive sheaves. Its scalar formula proves successor compatibility on tensor generators, since the completed-ring projections form a cone. Extend by local tensor generation. Finally use NatTrans.ofOpSequence and limit.lift to construct the comparison map, and limit.lift_π for its finite projections.

def completedConstantComparisonMap (X : Scheme.{u})
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (I : Ideal A)
    (φ : adicLisseConstantRing X (AdicCompletion I A) ⟶ adicLisseCompletedRing X I)
    (hφ : ∀ n : ℕ, φ ≫ limit.π (adicLisseRingSystem X I) (op n) =
      (constantSheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1}).map
        (CommRingCat.ofHom (AdicCompletion.evalₐ I (n + 1)).toRingHom))
    (N : ModuleCat.{u + 1} (AdicCompletion I A)) :
    (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars ((adicLisseForget X).map
      (completedConstantBaseMap X I φ))).obj ((completedConstantRealization X I φ).obj N) ⟶
        adicLisseCompletedModule X I (completedConstantUnderlyingModule I N)
